=='''Overview'''==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Mythic}} unit. He is only obtainable by evolving [[Jackal]].
He is also the boss of stage 6 of [[Story#Spirit World|Spirit World]] as The Wolf.

== Passive Ability: Los Lobos ==
{{PAGENAME}} summons a Spirit Wolf with 1 HP that deals 1/3 (33.34%) of {{PAGENAME}}'s current damage upon death, which it hits anyone within the explosion radius. The explosion even hits flying enemies. 

==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
